title: Evidence-class non-conversion and authority-substitution firewall
hypothesis: An evidence-class firewall can reject attempts to relabel local engineering, synthetic, documentary, or same-owner reproduction evidence as empirical, legal, cultural, production, or independently reproduced evidence even when every local check passes.
null_or_failure: A class label changes without new qualifying evidence, a technical artifact substitutes for affected-party or Māori authority, same-owner parity becomes independent reproduction, a protocol becomes a real result, a draft becomes stable authority, negatives shrink, or terminal readiness becomes true.
test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate evidence-class labels, source status, authority role, real-row count, production status, reproduction owner, negative count, protected claims, and terminal state; require every unsupported conversion to fail closed.
rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the converted claim, retain the substitution vector, restore the canonical evidence class and negative count, regenerate derived views from phase truth, and keep the terminal verdict not ready until each gate independently passes.
boundary: Evidence classes are non-convertible without qualifying external evidence; terminal readiness remains false.
